findings.description: IKEv2 provides streamlined 4-message exchange, built-in DoS cookie protection, and robust MOBIKE extension support.

findings.threatName: Cipher Block Chaining Mode Padding Attacks
findings.description: AES-CBC requires separate HMAC hashing and is vulnerable to padding oracle attacks if implementation timing varies.
findings.remediation: Prefer Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) modes like AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

findings.description: Meets NIST SP 800-77 guidelines offering at least 112 to 128 bits of equivalent security strength against discrete logarithm attacks.
PFS cannot be determined from an IKE_SA_INIT exchange alone.
findings.remediation: Capture CREATE_CHILD_SA exchanges or provide an explicit Child SA configuration.

findings.description: ESP sequence numbers do not reveal the configured replay window.
findings.remediation: Provide Child SA configuration or negotiated ESN evidence.

primaryFeatures.name: Mean Packet Size
primaryFeatures.explanation: Payload size footprint aligns with typical VoIP / Audio Call framing.

primaryFeatures.name: Packet Size Std Dev
primaryFeatures.explanation: High uniformity indicates fixed-rate codec audio transmission.

primaryFeatures.name: Inter-Arrival Time (IAT)
primaryFeatures.explanation: Rapid saturated transmissions typical of high-bandwidth transfer.

primaryFeatures.name: Ciphertext Entropy
primaryFeatures.explanation: Entropy describes byte distribution but cannot prove encryption or reveal the application inside ESP.

workloadHeuristic.evidence: Rule-based traffic pattern match from aggregate ESP metadata; percentages are relative scores, not calibrated probabilities.
